08 Notes & methodology

Open/done counts and the operator-item list come straight from scripts/plan-hygiene/epic_report_data.py --epic observability_master --json (same dedup methodology as /open-task-count), run fresh immediately before this report was written — not hand-counted. parent_epic: membership is frontmatter-grep, not the filename-substring inventory method.

Corpus scan: 40 child docs (19 plan + 21 issue) at pass start, partitioned into 5 disjoint 8-doc batches read end-to-end by 5 parallel sub-agent hunters (contradiction / done-but-unchecked / AO-dispatch-readiness / hedge-pointer / zero-checkbox sweeps per task_template.md §3), each independently verifying HARD evidence (git merge-base --is-ancestor against origin/live-defi-rollout) before recommending any checkbox flip. This report's own count (41 docs) reflects the one new issue doc filed mid-pass.

Assumption flagged: two checkbox flips this pass (tradfi_bf_cme option-B item; the monitoring_control_plane rollout-ratchet pair) rest on a shipped commit's own text describing intent to close a sibling doc, where the commit's Closes: trailer didn't literally name this specific doc — treated as sufficient given independently-verified structural evidence the fix covers this doc's exact case, but flagged here rather than silently assumed.
